seed_policy.rumor: SHA256 pilot-protocol-rumor-v1:{master}:{dataset}, first 8 bytes; sample actual sorted node IDs; fixed across p/methods/repeats
seed_policy.final_evaluation: second half of block, optimization first half; same final schedule within comparison; no guarantee of edge-level common outcomes

runtime_scope.runner_total: API entry through primary artifacts; excludes config file parsing, process imports, last metadata/summary writes and rename
runtime_scope.subprocess_wall: includes Python/CLI startup and successful publish
runtime_scope.orchestration_breakdown: nested subcomponents; do not double-count in total
runtime_scope.row_totals: comparison_runner_total_seconds repeats on each method row: sum once per case_id

diagnostic_scope.pooled_control: 3*200 independent final observations conditional on one fixed R
diagnostic_scope.precision: nested prefixes of final observations; required S are plug-in estimates, not measured runs
diagnostic_scope.gap_flags: descriptive only; |final - training| > max(1% n, 2 final SE), not a hypothesis test
